findings.description: Documented Penicillin Allergy Violation: Amoxicillin-clavulanate administered despite prominent allergy documentation, creating catastrophic anaphylaxis risk.
Severe Nephrotoxic Aminoglycoside Overdose: Gentamicin 320 mg IV q8h administered in severe renal impairment (eGFR 18 mL/min, Serum Creatinine 3.9 mg/dL).
High-Risk Drug Interaction: Warfarin co-prescribed with TMP-SMX inhibiting CYP2C9 clearance, causing acute bleeding vulnerability.
Critical Diagnostic Misclassification: Severe septic shock and multi-organ dysfunction labeled merely as "acute viral fever".

explainedTerms.definition: Measurement of specific drug levels at timed intervals to maintain constant concentrations in a patients bloodstream, preventing toxicity.
Key marker of kidney function; dictates dosing adjustments for renally cleared medications like aminoglycosides.
